insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Errors
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change is part of API version 2026-10 and aims to prevent silently returning incorrect results. It ensures that developers are aware of and can handle such queries properly.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their GraphQL queries to ensure they are not filtering by metafields that are not set up for filtering. They should update their code to handle the new error response and provide a better experience for merchants. This change affects how apps interact with the GraphQL Admin API, particularly when querying metafields. Developers should test their apps with the new API version to catch and fix any issues.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and reliable data as developers update their apps to handle the new error response. This change helps prevent incorrect results from being returned, ensuring that merchants have confidence in the data provided by apps.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it improves the overall reliability and accuracy of data returned by the GraphQL Admin API. By returning an error instead of incorrect results, Shopify ensures that developers can build more robust and trustworthy apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { id } } } }

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: Invalid metafield queries in the GraphQL Admin API now return errors instead of incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, introducing a simpler way to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, simplifying the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI version 13.0.2 adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: Updated App Store requirements include using a unique name for your app to reduce merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports channelId, allowing apps to apply a specific sales channel's context to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS, GraphQL, and Liquid functionality

themes.title: POS and Printing
themes.detail: The new Printing API (shopify.printing) allows POS UI extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers. This update is part of POS UI Extensions 2026-07.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Events
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries starting in API version 2026-10. Additionally, new metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, including Order, Collection, and Location updates.

themes.title: Liquid Templates
themes.detail: The Liquid July ’26 developer preview introduces a new way to build theme pages using blocks and partials, simplifying page structure and editing.

actions.text: Update POS UI extensions to use the new Printing API
